result_text:
The "Undefined Team" now only collects active contributors. The module compiles and the `Landscape*` tests pass, but I didn't add a test for the new filter.

The change is in `belongsToUndefinedTeam` in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`. It now returns `contributor.getContributor().isActive()`. The old check, `!undefinedTeam.getMembers().contains(email)`, looked up a String in a list of `ContributorRepositories`, so it was always true.

A blank latest-commit date already counts as active, because `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange` returns true for blank input. Configured teams don't go through this check, so they keep all their members. I also updated the method's Javadoc.
